title: The Day of Pentecost

questions.question: When the day of Pentecost arrived, what sound came from heaven that filled the entire house?
options: Like a choir of angels singing
Like thunder from a distant storm
questions.explanation: Acts 2:2 (ESV): "And suddenly there came from heaven a sound like a mighty rushing wind, and it filled the entire house where they were sitting."

questions.question: What appeared and rested on each of the disciples at Pentecost?
options: A white dove above each head
A pillar of cloud over each
questions.explanation: Acts 2:3 (ESV): "And divided tongues as of fire appeared to them and rested on each one of them."

questions.question: What happened to the disciples after they were filled with the Holy Spirit?
options: They began to speak in other tongues as the Spirit gave them utterance
They fell to the ground and shook violently
They rose and immediately preached in the temple courts
They wept for two hours with great joy
questions.correctAnswer: They began to speak in other tongues as the Spirit gave them utterance
questions.explanation: Acts 2:4 (ESV): "And they were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak in other tongues as the Spirit gave them utterance."

questions.question: Some in the crowd mocked the disciples, saying they were drunk. What did Peter say in response about the time of day?
options: "These people are not drunk, as you suppose, since it is only the third hour of the day."
"No man of God would drink before the Sabbath ends."
"We have not eaten nor drunk anything since dawn."
"We are filled not with wine but with living water."
questions.correctAnswer: "These people are not drunk, as you suppose, since it is only the third hour of the day."
questions.explanation: Acts 2:15 (ESV): "For these people are not drunk, as you suppose, since it is only the third hour of the day."

questions.question: Peter quoted from Joel saying: "And in the last days it shall be, God declares, that I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh, and your sons and daughters shall prophesy, and your young men shall see visions, and..."?
questions.explanation: Acts 2:17 (ESV): "'And in the last days it shall be, God declares, that I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh, and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, and your young men shall see visions, and your old men shall dream dreams;'"

questions.question: Peter declared that God raised Jesus up "because it was not possible for him to be held by" what?
questions.explanation: Acts 2:24 (ESV): "God raised him up, loosing the pangs of death, because it was not possible for him to be held by it."

questions.question: Peter quoted David from Psalm 16 about not abandoning his soul to Hades. What was Peter's key argument about David?
options: David died and was buried, so David was prophesying about the Christ whose soul would not be abandoned to Hades
David was the greatest king and would not be abandoned by God
David wrote this Psalm after seeing a vision of the resurrection
David meant that all righteous men would escape death entirely
questions.correctAnswer: David died and was buried, so David was prophesying about the Christ whose soul would not be abandoned to Hades
questions.explanation: Acts 2:29-31 (ESV): "Brothers, I may say to you with confidence about the patriarch David that he both died and was buried... Being therefore a prophet... he foresaw and spoke about the resurrection of the Christ, that he was not abandoned to Hades..."

questions.question: Peter concluded his sermon: "Let all the house of Israel therefore know for certain that God has made him both Lord and Christ, this Jesus..."?
questions.explanation: Acts 2:36 (ESV): "Let all the house of Israel therefore know for certain that God has made him both Lord and Christ, this Jesus whom you crucified."

questions.question: When the crowd was cut to the heart and asked "what shall we do?", what did Peter command them?
options: "Repent and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit."
"Believe in your heart and confess with your mouth and you shall be saved."
"Fast for three days and pray for forgiveness of your sins."
"Give alms to the poor and offer sacrifice at the temple."
questions.correctAnswer: "Repent and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit."
questions.explanation: Acts 2:38 (ESV): "And Peter said to them, 'Repent and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.'"

questions.question: How many souls were added that day after Peter's sermon?
questions.explanation: Acts 2:41 (ESV): "So those who received his word were baptized, and there were added that day about three thousand souls."

questions.question: The four practices of the early Jerusalem church are listed. Which of the following is NOT one of them?
options: Making pilgrimages to the temple on feast days
questions.correctAnswer: Making pilgrimages to the temple on feast days
questions.explanation: Acts 2:42 (ESV): "And they devoted themselves to the apostles' teaching and the fellowship, to the breaking of bread and the prayers."

questions.question: How did the early believers handle their possessions and needs?
options: They sold their possessions and goods and distributed the proceeds to all as any had need
They gave a tenth of all they had to the apostles
They kept their property separate and gave only when asked
They pooled only food and never sold real estate
questions.correctAnswer: They sold their possessions and goods and distributed the proceeds to all as any had need
questions.explanation: Acts 2:45 (ESV): "And they were selling their possessions and belongings and distributing the proceeds to all, as any had need."

questions.question: "And the Lord added to their number day by day those who were being..."?
questions.explanation: Acts 2:47 (ESV): "praising God and having favor with all the people. And the Lord added to their number day by day those who were being saved."

questions.question: Peter also quoted from Psalm 110 about the Lord saying to David's lord: "Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies..."?
questions.explanation: Acts 2:35 (ESV): "until I make your enemies your footstool."

questions.question: The promise of the Holy Spirit, Peter said, is "for you and for your children and for all who are far off, everyone whom the Lord our God calls to himself." From what prophecy was this idea drawn?
options: Joel 2, which Peter had just quoted
questions.correctAnswer: Joel 2, which Peter had just quoted
questions.explanation: Acts 2:39 (ESV): "For the promise is for you and for your children and for all who are far off, everyone whom the Lord our God calls to himself." This expands on the Joel 2 passage Peter had just quoted.

key_verse_text: "Repent and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit."
